question: Should the shared localization runtime and privileged catalog-refresh workflow be accepted as the prerequisite stack before this wizard-specific slice is reviewed for landing?
rationale: The branch introduces a new shared package and credential-sensitive workflow while depending on an open prerequisite, so only maintainers can choose whether to land the foundation separately, accept the cumulative stack, or pause the direction.

options.title: Land the foundation first
options.body: Review and land the shared prerequisite, then restack this PR onto current main as a narrow wizard catalog/rendering change.

options.title: Review as one stack
options.body: Explicitly accept the cumulative runtime, workflow, and wizard surface as one coordinated implementation stack and assign owners for the trust-boundary review.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Keep the PR draft until maintainer direction confirms that shared localization infrastructure belongs in core.

recommendation.title: Land the foundation first
recommendation.body: Review and land the shared prerequisite, then restack this PR onto current main as a narrow wizard catalog/rendering change.

likelyOwner.reason: The related prerequisite identifies Patrick as the primary implementation-stack reviewer.
